answer:
The two roles that have the highest proportion of association with requirements in ML-enabled systems are the **Project Lead** (or Project Manager, corresponding to `Q8_ML_Addressing_Project_Lead`) and the **Data Scientist** (corresponding to `Q8_ML_Addressing_Data_Scientist`). 

In the empirical survey data after excluding non-responses/negative skip codes ($N = 194$ valid respondents):
- **Project Lead / Project Manager**: Endorsed by 51.03% (99/194) of respondents, with a 10,000-iteration bootstrap mean of 51.02% (95% CI [43.81%, 58.25%]).
- **Data Scientist**: Endorsed by 48.97% (95/194) of respondents, with a 10,000-iteration bootstrap mean of 48.90% (95% CI [41.75%, 56.19%]).

Both roles significantly outperform all other organizational roles evaluated in the study:
- Business Analyst: 25.77% (50/194, 95% CI [19.59%, 31.96%])
- Developer: 19.07% (37/194, 95% CI [13.92%, 24.74%])
- Solution Architect: 12.37% (24/194, 95% CI [8.25%, 17.01%])
- Requirements Engineer: 10.31% (20/194, 95% CI [6.19%, 14.95%])
- Others: 9.79% (19/194, 95% CI [5.67%, 13.93%])
- Tester: 1.03% (2/194, 95% CI [0.00%, 2.58%])

Inferential bootstrap paired contrasts demonstrate that both the Project Lead and Data Scientist have a statistically significantly higher proportion of association with ML requirements than any subsequent role ($P(\text{Lead} > \text{Business Analyst}) = 1.000$, $\Delta = 25.23\%$, 95% CI [15.98%, 34.02%]; $P(\text{Data Scientist} > \text{Business Analyst}) = 1.000$, $\Delta = 23.11\%$, 95% CI [13.40%, 32.47%]).

### Informe Detallado para el Investigador (Spanish Synthesis)

Estimado/a colega:

Conforme a la aprobación de la propuesta metodológica, hemos ejecutado el pipeline computacional integral sobre `data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv` (script reproducible disponible en `analysis.py`).

1. **Preprocesamiento y Depuración Muestral:**
   De los 276 registros totales, 82 participantes con códigos negativos (`-77`) que no completaron la sección de asignación de roles fueron sistemáticamente excluidos, fijando la cohorte válida de análisis en $N = 194$.

2. **Resultados del Remuestreo No Paramétrico por Bootstrapping ($B = 10,000$ réplicas):**
   - **Project Lead / Project Manager** (`Q8_ML_Addressing_Project_Lead`): Media puntual = 51.03%, Media bootstrap = 51.02% (SE = 3.58%, IC 95% [43.81%, 58.25%]).
   - **Data Scientist** (`Q8_ML_Addressing_Data_Scientist`): Media puntual = 48.97%, Media bootstrap = 48.90% (SE = 3.61%, IC 95% [41.75%, 56.19%]).
   - En contraste, los roles tradicionales de ingeniería de requerimientos presentan tasas marcadamente inferiores: *Business Analyst* (25.79%), *Developer* (19.02%), *Solution Architect* (12.37%), y *Requirements Engineer* (10.32%).

3. **Conclusión Científica:**
   Los requerimientos en sistemas de Machine Learning son gestionados predominantemente de manera compartida entre el **Project Lead** (dimensión organizativa/de gestión) y el **Data Scientist** (dimensión técnica/estadística), consolidándose ambos como los dos roles con la más alta proporción de asociación con requerimientos en sistemas ML.
